evals.prompt: I run a small web design agency in Munich. Set up an automated way to find hairdressers and physiotherapists with bad or missing websites and email them.
evals.expected_output: Setup steps and commands for the find, audit and outreach pipeline
expectations: Creates or describes acquisition.json with queries for hairdressers and physiotherapists and Munich as a city
Runs the audit step before outreach
Mentions a daily send limit or gradual ramp-up

evals.prompt: Run my client acquisition every weekday morning automatically using GitHub Actions.
evals.expected_output: A scheduled GitHub Actions workflow running acquire.py run --send
expectations: Uses a schedule trigger with a weekday cron expression
Passes API keys and SMTP credentials from repository secrets
